title: SIMPLE mode invents a governable split (30% treasury / 51% quorum / turnout <= 80%)
notes: 0.33.0 SIMPLE-mode synthesis. S58 passes a fully-specified ADVANCED `params` object and never touches symbol/totalSupply, so SAFE_DEFAULT_TREASURY_PCT (30) and SAFE_DEFAULT_QUORUM_PCT (51) had never run against a chain. 30% treasury leaves 70% votable and 51/70 = 72.86% required turnout, under the 80% margin ceiling. Step 2 pins the refusal side: 60% treasury with a 51% quorum is UNREACHABLE (quorum > the votable share), and the tool must refuse with both numeric ways out rather than deploy a governance-dead brick that cannot be repaired, because repairing a quorum means passing a proposal under the quorum being repaired. Both steps are dryRun — nothing is deployed. Requires DEXE_PINATA_JWT: dexe_dao_create checks for it before any dryRun branch. `dao` is unused (the composite would deploy a fresh DAO) but kept for allowlist parity.
